title: Update medical documents for a combatant registration
summary: Registered combatants must update their medical documents through the Service NSW website to continue competing in combat sports in NSW.
intro: As a registered combatant, you must provide the Combat Sports Authority with updated medical documents to compete in combat sports contests in NSW. As a registered combatant, you must:
who_can_apply: You must be a registered combatant.
what_you_need: Your combatant registration number (Note: Check details at Verify NSW)
A signed Parent/Legal Guardian Consent form (required for applicants under 18 years of age)

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Enter your registration and MDU numbers, these can be found on your MDU notice.
Follow the prompts to provide updated medical documents.

more_info.text: You must take your medical record book with you to the medical practitioner when obtaining updated medical documents. The medical practitioner is required to complete the approved Certificate of Fitness and/or the Serological Clearance Certificate forms as well as the Certificate of Fitness and Serological Clearance Certificate history pages contained within your medical record book.
You must take your medical record book to all contests you compete in and show it to the attending medical practitioner.
If you need to update your details, go to Change name or contact details on a combatant registration.

internal_links.text: Change name or contact details on a combatant registration

faqs.q: Who needs to update their medical documents?
faqs.a: You must be a registered combatant.

faqs.q: Where can I check my combatant registration number?
faqs.a: You can check your combatant registration number and details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to update my medical records?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your combatant registration number, your MDU number, and the required PDF forms.
